analysis.confidence_intervals: None: no pooled independent-task interval; retain per-repetition paired counts.
analysis.primary: Coverage, wrong claims / definite claims, and correct definite claims / completed episodes, stratified by model/profile/case and target.

baseline_scope: Offline factual-trace audit ablations, not causal attribution or faithful CAR/VerifiedToolCalls reproductions. No baseline generation calls.

exposure.wording_exposure: As declared by the research protocol; previously exposed refund-case-note family is identified explicitly if selected.

failure_policy: Never regenerate a started slot. Failures and interrupted partials remain in the denominator. Resume only unstarted slots. No provider retries. Stop this invocation after transport/HTTP/identity/pre-call failure, preserving later slots as unstarted; malformed model decisions remain failed samples.
gold: Evaluator-only direct simulator ledger predicate, independent of verification results; retained separately and never supplied to policies or auditors.

methods.agent_self_report: Final structured assessment: success=true, failure=false, partial/unknown=unknown; same reported effect proxy for both targets.
methods.consequa_state_origin: Same readback plus captured provenance; package state verifier and action_linked_consequence mapping. No evaluator truth.
methods.independent_public_reference: Independent transparent contract+provenance join over the same public readback and action as Consequa-X; no package verifier/target helper or evaluator truth.
methods.readback_state_only: Same captured independent readback and contract, provenance removed; state verifier only, action-linkage abstains.
methods.response_only: Last public response: success=true, error=false, timeout/missing=unknown. Same naive acknowledgment proxy for state and action-linked target.

order: Randomized repetition/model/profile/case blocks, frozen before generation; same world and requested model phase seeds across all model/profile cells.
sampling_unit: Fixed declared simulator cases; repetitions are model/world seed controls, not independent task families. Wording controls do not hold out fault mechanisms. Model size/family are confounded.
